_comment: Input corpus for the cadre select differential harness.
Not an exhaustive sweep of the ruleset -- 147 routes, 22 risk rules and 20
context packs cannot be enumerated here, and a corpus that tried would be
a second copy of routing.json rather than a test of it. Each case instead
pins a distinct *shape* the plan can take, and says which one in `why`.
Every case passes --files explicitly. Omitting it makes the selector read
git status, which is not reproducible, so a corpus case that relied on it
would fail for reasons unrelated to selection.
Adding a case is cheap and welcome. Deleting one needs a reason beyond
'it looks like that other case' -- read its `why` first.
